g.text: 01 / ORCHESTRA
A cloud-native, node-based platform for designing, running and deploying AI pipelines through a visual interface. Models, tools,
data sources and processing steps connect as modular, reusable nodes, so complex workflows come together without extensive
boilerplate. Built for both experimentation and production, it supports cloud execution and scalable orchestration, and any
workflow can be exported as an API endpoint to plug into applications, automate tasks or run as a production service. The goal is
one environment that carries an idea from rapid prototype to large-scale cloud execution, with flexibility and developer
experience first.
NODE-BASED WORKFLOWS · AI PIPELINES · CLOUD EXECUTION · API EXPORT
02 / LOOMIS
A fully local, terminal-based code assistant in the spirit of Claude Code and Gemini CLI, but with no cloud dependency. A small
language model served through llama.cpp answers questions over a codebase using retrieval-augmented generation: code is embedded
with a code-specialised model into LanceDB, and hybrid vector and full-text search retrieves the relevant chunks from a corpus of
roughly 70,000. A Rust CLI streams responses into the terminal, a Python sidecar handles embeddings, and a TUI front end is in
development. Everything runs on-device and stays usable on modest hardware.
RUST · PYTHON · LANCEDB · LLAMA.CPP · HYBRID RAG · LOCAL SLM
03 / CONDUIT
A local-first MCP gateway that sits between AI agent clients such as Claude Desktop and Cursor and multiple backend MCP servers.
It aggregates and namespaces their tools behind one endpoint, and applies masking, blocking and parameter-mutation rules, with Lua
hooks for custom behavior, to everything passing through. Built as a Rust workspace with stdio and SSE transports and SQLite
storage, it ships a SolidJS dashboard embedded in the binary, giving live session inspection and a REST observability API from a
single local process.
RUST · SOLIDJS · TYPESCRIPT · SQLITE · AXUM · MCP
04 / MARKITDOWN-RUST-PY
A Rust-core reimplementation of MarkItDown, exposed to Python through PyO3. It converts documents such as CSV and HTML into clean
Markdown with a small memory footprint and fast start-up, aimed at document ingestion pipelines that feed LLM and RAG workflows.
It is built in phases: the CSV and HTML converters are in place and more formats are on the way, all behind a plain Python
interface.
RUST · PYO3 · PYTHON · MARKDOWN
05 / POSEFIT WEB
A browser-based AI fitness coach that estimates body pose from the camera feed in real time. A Rust core compiled to WebAssembly
works alongside MediaPipe to process pose landmarks, and a React interface turns them into live feedback while you exercise. It
runs as a web app deployed on Vercel, so there is nothing to install and the analysis happens in the browser.
RUST · WASM · MEDIAPIPE · REACT · VERCEL
06 / NOVELREAD
A lightweight, mobile-friendly reading platform for discovering, organizing and reading digital books and documents through a
clean interface tuned for mobile performance. Built with cloud integration in mind, it lets readers open their library on any
device, synchronize progress and keep content organized without relying on local storage. The streamlined architecture favors fast
loading and efficient resource use, so reading stays smooth even on devices with limited resources: simple, portable and
accessible, with the reach of the cloud.
MOBILE · CLOUD SYNC · LIGHTWEIGHT · READING
